fields.value: The Smiley Face Collection features handcrafted accessories that radiate warmth and positivity. Each piece is designed with vibrant yarns and cheerful motifs to remind you, even on tough days, that “Everything will be ok.” Add a touch of joy to your wardrobe with these playful, uplifting designs.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Earrings - Pop
node.description: A playful blend of polka-dot ceramic beads and linen thread creates an unbreakable vase with a youthful charm. The colour-block design and unique 3D crochet texture add an artistic touch, showcasing meticulous craftsmanship.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Earrings - Brown
node.description: A playful blend of polka-dot ceramic beads and linen thread creates an unbreakable vase with a youthful charm. The colour-block design and unique 3D crochet texture add an artistic touch, showcasing meticulous craftsmanship.

node.title: I Love Beer Bag
node.description: The joy of summer is all about ice-cold beer! With vibrant contrasting colors, a frosty beer design, a calm smile, and playful pop dancing butterflies, this bag captures the lively spirit of summer. Just remember, enjoy in moderation! The bag features a mix of vivid memories of good times, with unique patterns on each side, bold colors combinations, and a stretchy, open-knit strap that’s both soft and durable. Perfect for adding a cheerful touch to your summer!

node.title: Radioactivity Bag - Blue
node.description: A radiating pattern knitted with wool in various textures and colours. This double-sided bag features black dots that expand in a gradient pattern on one side, and white dots on the other. Each side is accented with playful wool pom-poms, and the strap is crafted with deep blue cotton yarn for added charm. The details make this wool-knit tote a piece you’ll fall in love with.

node.title: Radioactivity Bag - Green
node.description: A radiating pattern knitted with wool in various textures and colours. This double-sided bag features black dots that expand in a gradient pattern on one side, and white dots on the other. Each side is accented with playful wool pom-poms, and the strap is crafted with deep blue cotton yarn for added charm. The details make this wool-knit tote a piece you’ll fall in love with.

node.title: Smiley Face Earrings - Yellow
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this sunlit smiley face. On every rough day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Crafted with colourful cotton yarn and ceramic seed beads, this cheerful little smiley brings a boost of good vibes.

node.title: Smiley Face Earrings - Green
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this sunlit smiley face. On every rough day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Crafted with colourful cotton yarn and ceramic seed beads, this cheerful little smiley brings a boost of good vibes.

node.title: Smiley Face Earrings - Pink
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this sunlit smiley face. On every rough day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Crafted with colourful cotton yarn and ceramic seed beads, this cheerful little smiley brings a boost of good vibes.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Necklace - Brown
node.description: Soft and delicate, yet unbreakable. This brown crochet vase necklace is versatile and allows you to place small flowers inside, adding a practical and personal touch.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Necklace - Pop
node.description: Soft and delicate, yet unbreakable. This brown crochet vase necklace is versatile and allows you to place small flowers inside, adding a practical and personal touch.

node.title: Lazy Dachshunds Earrings
node.description: I’ll express my love freely and wholeheartedly—I absolutely adore dachshunds.

node.title: Coffee Bean Earrings
node.description: A cup of coffee, happiness takes off. Energising, refreshing, and full of delightful aromas, this coffee-themed collection doubles the joy with each order. Handmade double-sided 3D crochet coffee beans, packed with details—caffeine awakens my happiness.

node.title: Too Hot Blossom Earrings
node.description: A cherry blossom shape crocheted with pink cotton yarn, accented by a green centre and yellow beads, giving it a full dose of soothing pink charm.

node.title: Radioactive Globe Earrings
node.description: In response to global warming, we aim to raise awareness through our wool creations, hoping more people see the beauty and charm of our Earth that needs our protection! Made from eco-friendly materials—pure cotton yarn and Arctic velvet yarn (52% acrylic, 28% nylon, 20% polyester)—all sustainably dyed. Crafted with both crochet and hand-weaving techniques.

node.title: Pink Vapour Earrings
node.description: Pink fluffy round earrings. Perfect for flattering the face—an ideal choice for vacations.

node.title: Twistable Globe Earrings
node.description: A flexible Earth earring series that can be styled freely. Made from pure cotton yarn and Arctic velvet yarn (52% acrylic, 28% nylon, 20% polyester), all eco-friendly materials and sustainably dyed. Crafted with both crochet and hand-weaving techniques.

node.title: Blossoming Flower Earrings
node.description: Purple flower earrings. Made with eco-dyed cotton yarn, free from any additives.

node.title: I Love Beer Earrings
node.description: Turning joyful drinking memories into imagery. Day and night become vibrant and colourful with a drink in hand. Passing on happiness through yarn for you to enjoy! Lightweight crochet beer with a stainless steel rotating link, perfect for all seasons.

node.title: Super Sweet Heart Earrings
node.description: Retro colours combine matte red beads, blue cotton yarn, and silver glass yarn with polka dot art, offering a unique styling experience. This ultra-sweet accessory is a playful touch for the classic American girl. Timeless heart elements are filled with silver glass yarn, bordered with blue cotton yarn and red beads.

node.title: Balloon Flower Earrings
node.description: Original balloon flower earrings, filled with cotton. The cotton yarn is eco-dyed with no additives, ensuring an environmentally friendly touch.

node.title: Balloon Dog Earrings
node.description: Original balloon dog design. The earrings are filled with cotton, and the cotton yarn is eco-dyed with no additives.

node.title: Loving Smiley Face Hairband
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this bright, sunny smiley face. On every bad day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Made with colourful cotton and single-sided velvet yarn in an airy crochet design, this vibrant headband is perfect for summer. It features a mix of seven different colour-blocked patterns, including classic granny squares, pixelated hearts, smiley faces, and pixelated cow prints.

node.title: Milk Cow Hairband
node.description: Cows on the pasture bask in their own sunshine, relaxed and carefree. This headband is crafted from six different patterned blocks in an open-knit crochet style, featuring pixelated hearts, cow prints, and little cow heads. The colours are soft and irresistibly cute.

node.title: Shy Alien Earrings
node.description: Shy alien design. We bring innovative DNA to handcrafted crochet, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern trends. Made with eco-friendly dyes, free from any additives.

node.title: Sweet Heart Earrings
node.description: Retro colours blend matte red beads, blue cotton yarn, and silver glass yarn with polka dot art, offering a unique styling experience. This ultra-sweet accessory is a playful addition for the classic American girl. The timeless heart shape is filled with silver glass yarn, bordered with blue cotton yarn and red beads.

node.title: Pop Butterfly Earrings
node.description: A joyful butterfly dancing gracefully, featuring vibrant colours and accented with polka-dot beads.

node.title: I Love Beer Headscarf
node.description: The joy of summer comes from an ice-cold beer! Capturing those happy drinking memories, each piece in this series is crafted from crocheted fragments and stitched together. With high-contrast hearts, frosty beers, calm smiles, dancing butterflies, and a cheeky orange warning for the hangover aftermath, day and night are made brighter by these memories. I’m sharing my joy through yarn to bring you a happy summer! This triangular scarf is filled with cheerful patterns and features playful scalloped ties. Versatile and adaptable, it can be worn as a headscarf, neckerchief, top, belt, or even wall art—because your happiness is yours to create.

node.title: Milk Cow Necklace
node.description: Cows on the pasture bask in their sunshine, relaxed and carefree. This necklace features playful elements of little cows, hearts, and smiley faces. Black-and-white beads symbolize the cows, while colourful beads add a touch of whimsy.

node.title: Flat Cat Necklace
node.description: A happy black & white cat showing off its belly, inviting gentle rubs. Its tummy has matching black and white spots, purring contentedly.

node.title: Smiling Dog Earrings
node.description: A happy little dog with a smiling face, full of love for life, sports, and self-care! Let’s boost our dopamine and embrace joy together!

node.title: Smiling Heart Earrings
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this cheerful, sunlit smiley face. On every tough day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Made with colourful cotton yarn and ceramic seed beads in a crochet design, with a heart-shaped link in the centre. Winky! Playful, dangling heart earrings.

node.title: Twistable Flower Earrings
node.description: Flowers growing together toward the sun, with a branch shaped like the number “9” that can be styled freely. The little eyes on the flowers add a playful touch to the design.

node.title: Fluffy Radioactive Earrings
node.description: Original pom-pom earrings. The soft, fluffy balls are gentle on the skin. Made with eco-dyed cotton yarn, free from any additives.

node.title: Twistable Dog Ear Necklace
node.description: This necklace is made from imported antique beads, agate beads, and glass beads, with versatile black and white ceramic seed beads, highlighted by pops of vibrant orange and magenta. The adorable dog charm in the centre adds an extra touch of cuteness, making it a truly playful and eye-catching piece.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Lighter Bag
node.description: From the vase shape and pattern combinations to the hand-crocheted textures, every detail strives for precision and beauty. This small woven bag is perfect for holding a lighter, vape, or lipstick. The meticulous details enhance its uniqueness and practicality.

node.title: Coffee Bean Hairband
node.description: A cup of coffee, happiness takes off. This energising, refreshing, and aromatic coffee series doubles the joy with every order! Hand-crocheted coffee-themed headband, crafted with a mix of yarns. Packed with versatile details, it instantly perks you up and brings vibrant energy.

node.title: Yellow Radioactive Rings
node.description: This design plays with visual perception: the first ring is a light colour, the second is a dark black, and the final oversized ring with colour blocking draws the visual centre downward, enhancing the appearance of a smaller face and flattering facial shape.

node.title: Coffee Bean Necklace
node.description: This versatile handmade crochet coffee bean necklace can also be worn as a bracelet or waist chain, adding a stylish touch to any look.

node.title: Eyes of Radioactivity Earrings
node.description: Versatile purple fuzzy eye earrings. We bring innovative DNA to handcrafted crochet, allowing traditional craftsmanship to keep pace with modern trends. Made with eco-friendly dye, free from any additives.

node.title: Don't Stress Banana Earrings
node.description: Unique accessories that won’t blend in. May these earrings bring you good vibes every day, keeping anxiety at bay.

node.title: Flat Cat Earrings
node.description: A happy black & white cat showing off its belly, inviting gentle rubs. Its tummy features matching black and white spots, purring away contentedly.

node.title: Loving Smiling Face Necklace
node.description: I’ve fallen in love with this bright, sunlit smiley face. On every tough day, it seems to remind you, “Everything will be okay.” Crafted from colourful cotton yarn and ceramic seed beads, this handmade smiley charm is paired with beads in various materials and colours to create a cheerful necklace.

node.title: Pop Butterfly Necklace
node.description: A vibrant pop-art butterfly, handcrafted in crochet, with black, white, and yellow beads paired with shell accents—adding a full dose of dopamine to any outfit.

node.title: Unmatched Rainbow Earrings
node.description: An asymmetrical design with one long and one short piece. These rainbow earrings can be twisted freely to create any shape you desire.

node.title: Twistable Ear Dog Earrings
node.description: The ideal vacation life must include an adorable dog companion. Crafted from white and brown cotton yarn, this little dog head features lively eyes and a nose—utterly charming.

node.title: Unbreakable Vase Handbag
node.description: A blend of linen thread and metal with unique knitted designs on each side, creating a mysterious mix of colours and patterns. This vase-shaped bag is not only a decorative piece but also an expression of handmade craftsmanship, combining style with a sense of emotional and practical versatility. Designed with both handle and strap options, it can be adjusted for any look.
